name: fa_causal_softmax
desc: Single-warp CAUSAL FlashAttention forward microbench. Online-softmax core (running max/denominator, rescale across KV tiles) plus the causal mask (query row i attends only to key positions j<=i, applied as a predicated score->-inf override). SQ=32, D=16, seqlen_k=64 -> one partially-masked KV tile + one fully-masked tile (tests that an all-masked tile leaves the running max/denom unchanged). Toggle-free; only verified ops (FFMA, MUFU.EX2, FMNMX, ISETP/select, STS+BAR.SYNC). Verified vs a CPU causal-attention oracle.
